t: How I Finally Got My LLM to Play Nice With the Web UI
s: This article details the author's journey to enable LLMs to control web browsers via a command-and-control language and implement real-time streaming of LLM responses using WebSockets, overcoming challenges with Python generators for payload processing.
sub: LLM browser control with command-and-control language
Real-time LLM response streaming via WebSockets
Python generator challenges for payload processing
Server-Sent Events (SSE) implementation for browser alerts
